themes.quote: Our top three product priorities for 2026 are to grow the everything exchange, scale stablecoins and payments, and expand onchain adoption.

we anticipate the restructuring plan announced in May 2026 will help us better align our operating expenses with current market conditions and optimize our operations for the AI era
We announced the Everything Exchange in December 2025, and during the first quarter of 2026, we saw strong growth across derivatives, prediction markets, and decentralized exchange trading.
